 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE J. C. DOSHI  Date : 16/09/2025  ORAL ORDER Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By way of this petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India r/w section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the petitioner challenges order passed below Exh.1 in Criminal Case No.114 of 1992, whereby the criminal complaint was dismissed by the learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.6, Ahmedabad.

entities.text: Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.6, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This criminal complaint was filed by the Food Inspector u/s 2(ia)(a)
(m) r/w section 7(i) and 16(1)(a) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
That after conducting inquiry, Criminal Case No.114 of 1992 was registgered.
The complainant was given more than sufficient opportunity to remain present and to keep the accused present in this private complaint.

However, neither the complainant nor the NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/8312/2016 ORDER DATED: 16/09/2025 undefined accused did remain present before the learned trial Court,
State Of Gujarat vs Ashwinbhai Maganbhai Gaudani on 16 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84145550/
1 which ultimately resulted into issuance of warrant against the complainant.

entities.text: State Of Gujarat vs Ashwinbhai Maganbhai Gaudani
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Yet, he did not remain present to proceed further in the age old matter.

Ultimately, the learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.6, Ahmedabad dismissed the age old complaint on 23.6.2016 by giving more than sufficient opportunity in exercise of powers u/s 256 of the Code and acquitted the accused.

entities.text: Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.6, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: So, instead of filing acquittal appeal against said order, the prosecution has filed Special Criminal Application, which is not maintainable.

Therefore, without examining any further merit of the matter, present petition stands dismissed on the ground of maintainability reserving right in favour of the prosecution to file appropriate proceedings, if any, subject to law of limitation.

(J. C. DOSHI,J) SHEKHAR P. BARVE State Of Gujarat vs Ashwinbhai Maganbhai Gaudani on 16 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84145550/
